ei.title: The Role and Benefits of Wholesalers
ei.subject: 수능특강

fullPassage: A wholesaler is an organisation or individual acting as the middle step between a producer and a retailer. It is reasonable to ask what the point might be of having a wholesaler in the distribution channel. Why would the manufacturer not simply pass the sporting goods straight on to the retailer? However, a wholesaler can be important in helping other channel members. First, they usually buy goods in bulk from the manufacturer and then store them. When the retailer is ready to order some goods, the wholesaler transports the sporting goods to them. A wholesaler can also stock a large range of goods from a variety of different manufacturers. As a result, instead of having to contact all of these producers, the retailer only has to talk to the one wholesaler to gain access to a range of different sporting goods.

questions.passage: A wholesaler is an organisation or individual acting as the middle step between a producer and a retailer. It is (A)[reasonable / unreasonable] to ask what the point might be of having a wholesaler in the distribution channel. Why would the manufacturer not simply pass the sporting goods straight on to the retailer? However, a wholesaler can be (B)[important / trivial] in helping other channel members. First, they usually buy goods in bulk from the manufacturer and then store them. When the retailer is ready to order some goods, the wholesaler transports the sporting goods to them. A wholesaler can also stock a large range of goods from a (C)[uniformity / variety] of different manufacturers. As a result, instead of having to contact all of these producers, the retailer only has to talk to the one wholesaler to gain access to a range of different sporting goods.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① reasonable - important - variety = 원문과 일치 ←정답
❌ ② unreasonable(불합리한): 도매상의 역할을 묻는 것이 '합리적'이라는 원문과 정반대
❌ ③ trivial(사소한): 도매상이 유통에서 '중요할 수 있다'는 원문과 정반대
❌ ④ uniformity(획일성): 다양한 제조업체의 '다양한' 상품이라는 원문과 정반대
det.tip: reasonable(합리적인), important(중요한), variety(다양성)가 본문 핵심 어휘이다.

questions.passage: A wholesaler is an organisation or (A)[corporation / individual] acting as the middle step between a producer and a retailer. It is reasonable to ask what the point might be of having a wholesaler in the distribution channel. Why would the manufacturer not simply pass the sporting goods straight on to the retailer? However, a wholesaler can be important in helping other channel members. First, they usually buy goods in (B)[retail / bulk] from the manufacturer and then store them. When the retailer is ready to order some goods, the wholesaler (C)[transports / manufactures] the sporting goods to them. A wholesaler can also stock a large range of goods from a variety of different manufacturers. As a result, instead of having to contact all of these producers, the retailer only has to talk to the one wholesaler to gain access to a range of different sporting goods.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① corporation(기업): '개인'이라는 원문과 의미 범위가 다름
❌ ② retail(소매): '대량으로' 구매한다는 원문과 정반대
✅ ③ individual - bulk - transports = 원문과 일치 ←정답
❌ ④ manufactures(제조하다): 도매상이 상품을 '운송한다'는 원문과 역할이 다름
det.tip: individual(개인), in bulk(대량으로), transports(운송하다)가 도매상의 특성과 기능을 나타낸다.

questions.passage: A wholesaler is an organisation or individual acting as the middle step between a producer and a retailer. It is reasonable to ask what the point might be of having a wholesaler in the (A)[production / distribution] channel. Why would the manufacturer not simply pass the sporting goods straight on to the retailer? However, a wholesaler can be important in helping other channel members. First, they usually buy goods in bulk from the manufacturer and then (B)[store / discard] them. When the retailer is ready to order some goods, the wholesaler transports the sporting goods to them. A wholesaler can also stock a large range of goods from a variety of different manufacturers. As a result, instead of having to contact all of these producers, the retailer only has to talk to the one wholesaler to gain (C)[access / restriction] to a range of different sporting goods.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① production(생산): '유통' 채널이라는 원문과 의미가 다름
✅ ② distribution - store - access = 원문과 일치 ←정답
❌ ③ discard(폐기하다): 상품을 '저장한다'는 원문과 정반대
❌ ④ restriction(제한): 다양한 상품에 대한 '접근'을 얻는다는 원문과 정반대
det.tip: distribution channel(유통 채널), store(저장하다), gain access(접근을 얻다)는 도매 유통의 핵심 개념이다.

questions.passage: A wholesaler is an organisation or individual acting as the middle step between a producer and a retailer. It is ①<u>reasonable</u> to ask what the point might be of having a wholesaler in the distribution channel. Why would the manufacturer not ②<u>simply</u> pass the sporting goods straight on to the retailer? However, a wholesaler can be ③<u>insignificant</u> in helping other channel members. First, they usually buy goods in bulk from the manufacturer and then store them. When the retailer is ready to order some goods, the wholesaler transports the sporting goods to them. A wholesaler can also stock a large ④<u>range</u> of goods from a variety of different manufacturers. As a result, instead of having to contact all of these producers, the retailer only has to talk to the one wholesaler to gain access to a range of different sporting goods.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① reasonable(합리적인): 도매상의 역할을 묻는 것이 '합리적'이라는 문맥에 적절
✅ ② simply(단순히): 제조업체가 '단순히' 소매상에게 전달하지 않는 이유를 묻는 문맥에 적절
❌ ③ insignificant → important: 도매상이 다른 유통 참여자를 돕는 데 '중요할 수 있다'고 해야 뒤의 역할 설명과 일치 ←정답
✅ ④ range(범위): '넓은 범위'의 상품을 보유할 수 있다는 문맥에 적절
det.tip: important(중요한)는 도매상의 핵심 가치를 나타내며, 뒤에 이어지는 구체적 역할(대량 구매, 저장, 운송, 다양한 상품 보유)의 도입부이다.

questions.passage: A wholesaler is an organisation or individual acting as the ①<u>middle</u> step between a producer and a retailer. It is reasonable to ask what the point might be of having a wholesaler in the distribution channel. Why would the manufacturer not simply pass the sporting goods straight on to the retailer? However, a wholesaler can be important in helping other channel members. First, they usually ②<u>sell</u> goods in bulk from the manufacturer and then store them. When the retailer is ③<u>ready</u> to order some goods, the wholesaler transports the sporting goods to them. A wholesaler can also stock a large range of goods from a variety of different manufacturers. As a result, instead of having to ④<u>contact</u> all of these producers, the retailer only has to talk to the one wholesaler to gain access to a range of different sporting goods.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① middle(중간의): 생산자와 소매상 '사이'의 중간 단계라는 문맥에 적절
❌ ② sell → buy: 도매상이 제조업체로부터 상품을 대량으로 '구매한다'고 해야 뒤의 저장 및 배송 역할과 일치 ←정답
✅ ③ ready(준비된): 소매상이 주문할 '준비가 되면'이라는 문맥에 적절
✅ ④ contact(연락하다): 모든 생산자에게 '연락'해야 하는 대신이라는 문맥에 적절
det.tip: 도매상은 제조업체로부터 buy(구매)하여 store(저장)한 뒤 소매상에게 transport(운송)하는 흐름이다.

questions.passage: A wholesaler is an organisation or individual ①<u>acting</u> as the middle step between a producer and a retailer. It is reasonable to ask what the point might be of having a wholesaler in the distribution channel. Why would the manufacturer not simply pass the sporting goods straight on to the retailer? However, a wholesaler can be important in ②<u>helping</u> other channel members. First, they usually buy goods in bulk from the manufacturer and then store them. When the retailer is ready to order some goods, the wholesaler transports the sporting goods to them. A wholesaler can also ③<u>stock</u> a large range of goods from a variety of different manufacturers. As a result, instead of having to contact all of these producers, the retailer only has to talk to the one wholesaler to ④<u>lose</u> access to a range of different sporting goods.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① acting(역할을 하는): 중간 단계로 '역할을 하는'이라는 문맥에 적절
✅ ② helping(돕는): 다른 유통 참여자를 '돕는' 데 중요하다는 문맥에 적절
✅ ③ stock(비축하다): 다양한 상품을 '비축할' 수 있다는 문맥에 적절
❌ ④ lose → gain: 소매상이 다양한 스포츠용품에 대한 접근을 '얻기 위해' 도매상 한 곳과만 대화하면 된다고 해야 도매상의 이점과 일치 ←정답
det.tip: gain access to(~에 대한 접근을 얻다)는 도매상을 통한 소매상의 핵심 이점을 나타내는 표현이다.

questions.passage: A wholesaler is an organisation or individual acting as the middle step between a producer and a __________. It is reasonable to ask what the point might be of having a wholesaler in the distribution channel. Why would the manufacturer not simply pass the sporting goods straight on to the retailer? When the retailer is ready to order some goods, the wholesaler transports the sporting goods to them. A wholesaler can also stock a large range of goods from a variety of different manufacturers. As a result, instead of having to contact all of these producers, the retailer only has to talk to the one wholesaler to gain access to a range of different sporting goods.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 소매상 — 생산자와 소매상 사이의 중간 단계
det.analysis:
❌ ① manufacturer(제조업체): 이미 'producer'와 같은 역할이며 '사이'의 한쪽 끝이므로 중복
❌ ② wholesaler(도매상): 도매상 자체가 중간 단계이므로 'between a producer and a wholesaler'는 자기 자신을 가리키는 논리적 오류
❌ ③ producer(생산자): 'between a producer and a producer'가 되어 의미 불성립
✅ ④ retailer(소매상): 도매상이 생산자와 '소매상' 사이의 중간 단계라는 문맥에 부합 ←정답
det.tip: wholesaler(도매상)는 producer(생산자)와 retailer(소매상)를 연결하는 중간 역할이다.

questions.passage: A wholesaler is an organisation or individual acting as the middle step between a producer and a retailer. It is reasonable to ask what the point might be of having a wholesaler in the distribution channel. Why would the manufacturer not simply pass the sporting goods straight on to the retailer? However, a wholesaler can be important in helping other channel members. First, they usually buy goods in __________ from the manufacturer and then store them. When the retailer is ready to order some goods, the wholesaler transports the sporting goods to them. A wholesaler can also stock a large range of goods from a variety of different manufacturers. As a result, instead of having to contact all of these producers, the retailer only has to talk to the one wholesaler to gain access to a range of different sporting goods.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 대량으로 — 도매상이 제조업체로부터 대량으로 구매한다는 문맥
det.analysis:
✅ ③ bulk(대량): 도매상이 제조업체로부터 상품을 '대량으로' 구매한 뒤 저장한다는 문맥에 부합
❌ ① order(주문): 'buy goods in order'는 구매 행위 설명에 부자연스러움
❌ ② stock(비축): 'buy goods in stock'은 구매 방식이 아닌 저장 상태를 나타냄
❌ ④ range(범위): 'buy goods in range'는 관용적 표현이 아님
det.tip: in bulk(대량으로)는 도매상의 핵심 기능인 대량 구매를 나타내는 표현이다.

questions.passage: A wholesaler is an organisation or individual acting as the middle step between a producer and a retailer. It is reasonable to ask what the point might be of having a wholesaler in the distribution channel. Why would the manufacturer not simply pass the sporting goods straight on to the retailer? However, a wholesaler can be important in helping other channel members. First, they usually buy goods in bulk from the manufacturer and then store them. When the retailer is ready to order some goods, the wholesaler transports the sporting goods to them. questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 비축하다 — 도매상이 다양한 상품을 비축할 수 있다는 문맥
det.analysis:
✅ ④ stock(비축하다): 도매상이 다양한 제조업체의 넓은 범위의 상품을 '비축할' 수 있다는 문맥에 부합
❌ ① pass(전달하다): 본문에서 '직접 전달하다'에 쓰이지만, 'can also pass a large range'는 비축의 의미와 다름
❌ ② order(주문하다): 소매상이 '주문하다'에 쓰이지만, 도매상이 상품을 '주문할 수 있다'는 비축과 의미가 다름
❌ ③ buy(구매하다): 본문에서 대량 '구매하다'에 쓰이지만, 'can also buy a large range'는 이미 앞 문장과 중복
det.tip: stock(비축하다)은 도매상이 소매상에게 다양한 선택지를 제공하는 핵심 기능이다.

questions.passage: A wholesaler is an organisation or individual acting as the middle step between a producer and a retailer. It is <u>reasonable</u> to ask what the point might be of having a wholesaler in the distribution channel. Why would the manufacturer not simply pass the sporting goods straight on to the retailer? However, a wholesaler can be important in helping other channel members. First, they usually buy goods in bulk from the manufacturer and then store them. When the retailer is ready to order some goods, the wholesaler transports the sporting goods to them. A wholesaler can also stock a large range of goods from a variety of different manufacturers. As a result, instead of having to contact all of these producers, the retailer only has to talk to the one wholesaler to gain access to a range of different sporting goods.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 reasonable와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: 합리적인, 타당한 — 도매상의 역할을 묻는 것이 타당하다는 문맥
det.analysis:
✅ ① sensible(합리적인): reasonable과 의미가 가장 가깝다 ←정답
❌ ② affordable(저렴한): reasonable의 다른 의미(가격이 적당한)이지만 이 문맥과 맞지 않음
❌ ③ generous(관대한): 의미 축이 다름 (성격 vs 판단)
❌ ④ profitable(수익성 있는): 경제적 이득 축이며 타당성과 다름
det.tip: reasonable = sensible = logical. 이 문맥에서는 '합리적인, 타당한'의 의미이다.

questions.passage: A wholesaler is an organisation or individual acting as the middle step between a producer and a retailer. It is reasonable to ask what the point might be of having a wholesaler in the distribution channel. Why would the manufacturer not simply pass the sporting goods straight on to the retailer? However, a wholesaler can be important in helping other channel members. First, they usually buy goods in bulk from the manufacturer and then store them. When the retailer is ready to order some goods, the wholesaler <u>transports</u> the sporting goods to them. A wholesaler can also stock a large range of goods from a variety of different manufacturers. As a result, instead of having to contact all of these producers, the retailer only has to talk to the one wholesaler to gain access to a range of different sporting goods.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 transports와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: 운송하다 — 도매상이 소매상에게 스포츠용품을 운송한다는 문맥
det.analysis:
✅ ② delivers(배달하다): transports와 의미가 가장 가깝다
❌ ① produces(생산하다): 제조 과정이며 운송과 다름
❌ ③ purchases(구매하다): 구매 행위이며 운송과 다름
❌ ④ displays(진열하다): 소매 단계의 행위이며 운송과 다름
det.tip: transports = delivers = conveys. '운반하다, 운송하다'의 의미이다.

questions.passage: A wholesaler is an organisation or individual acting as the middle step between a producer and a retailer. It is reasonable to ask what the point might be of having a wholesaler in the distribution channel. Why would the manufacturer not simply pass the sporting goods straight on to the retailer? questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 variety와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① diversity(다양성): variety와 의미가 가장 가깝다
❌ ② quantity(수량): 양적 측면이며 다양성과 다름
❌ ③ quality(품질): 질적 수준이며 다양성과 다름
❌ ④ majority(대다수): 비율 축이며 다양성과 다름
det.tip: variety = diversity = assortment. '다양성, 여러 종류'의 의미이다.

questions.passage: A wholesaler is an organisation or individual acting as the middle step between a producer and a retailer. It is reasonable to ask what the point might be of having a wholesaler in the distribution channel. Why would the manufacturer not simply pass the sporting goods <u>straight</u> on to the retailer? However, a wholesaler can be important in helping other channel members. First, they usually buy goods in bulk from the manufacturer and then store them. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 straight와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ③ indirectly(간접적으로): straight(곧바로, 직접)의 반의어로 가장 적절하다
❌ ① quickly(빠르게): 속도 축이며 직접/간접 축과 다름
❌ ② carefully(조심스럽게): 태도 축이며 직접/간접 축과 다름
❌ ④ gradually(점진적으로): 속도/과정 축이며 직접/간접 축과 다름
det.tip: straight on(곧바로, 직접) ↔ indirectly(간접적으로). 도매상 없이 직접 전달하는 것 vs 중개를 통한 간접 전달.

questions.passage: A wholesaler is an organisation or individual acting as the middle step between a producer and a retailer. It is reasonable to ask what the point might be of having a wholesaler in the distribution channel. Why would the manufacturer not simply pass the sporting goods straight on to the retailer? However, a wholesaler can be important in helping other channel members. First, they usually buy goods in bulk from the manufacturer and then store them. When the retailer is ready to order some goods, the wholesaler transports the sporting goods to them. A wholesaler can also stock a large range of goods from a variety of different manufacturers. As a result, instead of having to contact all of these producers, the retailer only has to talk to the one wholesaler to <u>gain</u> access to a range of different sporting goods.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 gain와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ④ forfeit(상실하다): gain(얻다)의 반의어로 가장 적절하다
❌ ① seek(추구하다): 얻기 위한 노력이며 gain과 유사한 방향
❌ ② request(요청하다): 요구 행위이며 획득/상실 축과 다름
❌ ③ maintain(유지하다): 현상 유지이며 획득/상실의 어느 방향과도 다름
det.tip: gain ↔ forfeit / lose. '얻다' vs '상실하다, 잃다'의 대비이다.

questions.passage:
(A) Why would the manufacturer not simply pass the sporting goods straight on to the retailer?
(B) You need a valid pass to enter the restricted area of the building.
questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)의 밑줄 친 pass의 의미로 가장 적절하게 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① (A) '허가증'은 동사 문맥에 맞지 않음
❌ ② (A) '통과하다'는 상품 전달 맥락과 다름 + (B) '전달하다'는 명사 맥락과 맞지 않음
❌ ③ (A) '합격하다'는 시험 맥락이며 상품 전달과 무관
✅ ④ (A) 전달하다: 제조업체가 스포츠용품을 소매상에게 직접 '전달하다'라는 동사적 맥락 / (B) 허가증: 건물 제한 구역 진입을 위한 '허가증'이라는 명사적 맥락 ←정답
det.tip: pass는 '전달하다'(동사) / '허가증'(명사) / '통과하다'(동사) 등 다의어이다. 문맥에 따라 품사와 의미가 달라진다.

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a person or business that buys goods in large quantities from producers and sells them to retailers"

det.korean: 도매상 — 생산자로부터 대량으로 구매하여 소매상에게 판매하는 사업체
det.analysis:
✅ ② wholesaler(도매상): 생산자로부터 대량 구매 후 소매상에게 판매하는 사업체라는 정의에 정확히 부합
❌ ① retailer(소매상): 최종 소비자에게 판매하는 사업체로 정의와 다름
❌ ③ manufacturer(제조업체): 상품을 만드는 사업체로 중간 유통자가 아님
❌ ④ producer(생산자): 상품을 생산하는 주체로 중간 유통자가 아님
det.tip: wholesaler = 도매상. 본문에서는 producer와 retailer 사이의 중간 단계로 설명된다.

questions.passage: A wholesaler is an organisation or individual acting as the middle step between a __________ (produce) and a retailer.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어) (영어로)

det.korean: 사람을 나타내는 명사 형태가 필요하다. produce → producer
det.analysis: 'between a __________ and a retailer' 구조에서 관사 a 뒤에 사람/주체를 나타내는 명사가 필요하다. 동사 'produce'에 접미사 -r을 붙여 'producer(생산자)'로 바꾸면 retailer와 병렬 구조를 이룬다.
det.tip: produce(동사: 생산하다) → producer(명사: 생산자). -er 접미사는 행위자를 나타낸다.

questions.passage: It is reasonable to ask what the point might be of having a wholesaler in the __________ (distribute) channel.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어) (영어로)

det.analysis: 'the __________ channel' 구조에서 관사 the와 명사 channel 사이에 형용사적 기능의 명사가 필요하다. 동사 'distribute'를 명사 'distribution'으로 바꾸면 'distribution channel(유통 채널)'이라는 복합명사가 된다.
det.tip: distribute(동사: 유통하다) → distribution(명사: 유통). distribution channel은 '유통 채널'이라는 경제 용어이다.

questions.passage: A wholesaler is an organisation or individual acting as __________ between a producer and a retailer. It is reasonable to ask what the point might be of having a wholesaler in the distribution channel. Why would the manufacturer not simply pass the sporting goods straight on to the retailer? However, a wholesaler can be important in helping other channel members. First, they usually buy goods in bulk from the manufacturer and then store them. When the retailer is ready to order some goods, the wholesaler transports the sporting goods to them. A wholesaler can also stock a large range of goods from a variety of different manufacturers. As a result, instead of having to contact all of these producers, the retailer only has to talk to the one wholesaler to gain access to a range of different sporting goods.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 중간 단계 — 생산자와 소매상 사이의 중간 단계 역할
det.analysis:
✅ ① the middle step(중간 단계): 도매상이 생산자와 소매상 '사이의 중간 단계'로 역할한다는 문맥에 부합
❌ ② the final destination(최종 목적지): 도매상은 최종 목적지가 아닌 중간 유통자
❌ ③ the main producer(주요 생산자): 도매상은 생산자가 아닌 유통 중개자
❌ ④ the direct supplier(직접 공급자): 본문은 오히려 직접 공급하지 않는 이유를 설명
det.tip: the middle step between a producer and a retailer(생산자와 소매상 사이의 중간 단계)가 도매상의 핵심 정의이다.

questions.passage: A wholesaler is an organisation or individual acting as the middle step between a producer and a retailer. It is reasonable to ask what the point might be of having a wholesaler in the distribution channel. Why would the manufacturer not simply pass the sporting goods straight on to the retailer? However, a wholesaler can be important in helping other channel members. First, they usually buy goods in bulk from the manufacturer and then store them. When the retailer is ready to order some goods, the wholesaler transports the sporting goods to them. A wholesaler can also stock a large range of goods from a variety of different manufacturers. As a result, __________, the retailer only has to talk to the one wholesaler to gain access to a range of different sporting goods.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 이 모든 생산자에게 연락해야 하는 대신 — 도매상이 소매상의 연락 부담을 줄여주는 문맥
det.analysis:
❌ ① in addition to buying goods in bulk(대량 구매에 더하여): 앞 내용의 부연이지만, 뒤의 'the retailer only has to talk to the one wholesaler'와 대비 구조가 맞지 않음
❌ ② as a result of storing the sporting goods(스포츠용품 저장의 결과로): 인과 관계이지만 소매상의 연락 부담 감소와 직접 연결되지 않음
✅ ③ instead of having to contact all of these producers(이 모든 생산자에게 연락해야 하는 대신): 도매상 한 곳과만 대화하면 된다는 결론 앞에서 '여러 생산자에게 일일이 연락하는 것 대신'이라는 대비 구조에 부합 ←정답
❌ ④ because of the range of different manufacturers(다양한 제조업체 때문에): 이유 설명이지만 빈칸 뒤의 'only has to talk to the one wholesaler'와 대비 구조가 안 맞음
det.tip: instead of ~(~ 대신)는 도매상 없이 소매상이 겪을 불편함(여러 생산자에게 일일이 연락)과 도매상 있을 때의 편리함(한 곳에만 연락)을 대비한다.
